disclaimer: These are prompts for discussion with a qualified doctor, not a diagnosis or medical advice.

rules.rationale: Fatigue has many possible causes, and vegetarian diets can provide less vitamin B12 depending on food choices. Ask your doctor whether a vitamin B12 test is appropriate; these answers cannot establish a deficiency.
Fatigue is nonspecific and can have many causes. A doctor can assess your symptoms and decide whether a CBC or another evaluation is suitable.
A family history of diabetes can be one factor in deciding when to screen. Discuss your full risk profile and whether HbA1c or another screening test is appropriate with your doctor.
Hair fall has many possible causes. Given the reported family history, ask your doctor whether thyroid evaluation, which may include a TSH test, is suitable.
Bone pain and low sun exposure do not identify a cause. Discuss the symptoms with a doctor, who can decide whether vitamin D testing is appropriate.
